name: Chainsaw, petrol

comps.spec: 2-stroke petrol-oil mix, under 1 L; jerry cans of mix often nearby
Magneto ignition coil and spark plug
comps.loc: Beside the flywheel under the top cover

comps.spec: Recoil starter spring — springs out when the housing is opened

notes: Salvage: a two-stroke engine (30.1 cm³ and 1.2 kW on a STIHL MS 162, 50.2 cm³ and 2.4 kW on a Husqvarna 450 II, 72.2 cm³ and 4.4 kW on a STIHL MS 462), a clutch that couples it to the chain sprocket above idle, the drive sprocket on the clutch drum, the bar and chain, and fuel and chain-oil tanks, 0.40 L and 0.28 L on the STIHL MS 162/172 and 0.45 L and 0.26 L on the Husqvarna 450 II (STIHL MS 162/172, Husqvarna 450 II, STIHL MS 462, USFS chain saw course ch3, Oregon M&S 2004). It is loud, 104 dB(A) at the operator's ear on the Husqvarna 450 II, so wear muffs or plugs (Husqvarna 450 II). Run it outdoors only: the exhaust carries carbon monoxide (Husqvarna 450 II). A hot fuel tank can be under pressure and spray fuel when opened, so let the saw cool and open the cap slowly (STIHL MS 162/172).

sources.title: STIHL MS 162/172: STIHL, MS 162, 172 Instruction Manual, Canadian edition (0458-200-8221-A, 2025), chapters 3, 5, 23 and 25
Husqvarna 450 II: Husqvarna, Operator's manual 445 II, 445e II, 450 II, 450e II chainsaws (2024-02), safety and technical data
STIHL MS 462: STIHL Canada, MS 462 C-M gas chainsaw, technical data
USFS chain saw course ch3: USDA Forest Service, Chain Saw and Crosscut Saw Training Course, Student's Guidebook 0667-2805-MTDC (2006), chapter 3, Chain Saw Use and Maintenance
Oregon M&S 2004: Oregon (Blount), Maintenance & Safety Manual for Saw Chain, Guide Bars, and Drive Sprockets (F/N A106971 AG 0904), Oregon's own PDF, pp. 88-91 (drive sprockets and clutch drums)
